my: My things are things that belong to me.
Is this my book, or is it yours?
myself: You use myself when you are the doer and the receiver of an action.
If you do something by yourself, you do it without any help or alone.
You use myself to emphasize that it is you and not somebody else.
I know a lot of people love coffee, but I myself don't really like it.
mystery: A mystery is a secret or hidden matter which can't be explained.
She never told me where the money was, and it remains a mystery to me even now.
A mystery is a story about a puzzling event: short for mystery story.
The police investigation has failed to solve the murder mystery.
mythic: If something is mythic it is from a myth (a story about gods).
There are many mythic stories about the Norse god Thor.
If something is mythic it is not real or not true; that is, it is like something from an fictional story or old myth.
A dragon is a mythic animal.
If something is mythic or of mythic proportions it is very great or amazing.
His skill with the baseball bat was mythic.
mythical: If something is mythical it is from a myth (a story about gods).
There are many mythical stories about the Norse god Thor.
If something is mythical it is not real or not true; that is, it is like something from a fictional story or old myth.
A dragon is a mythical animal.
If something is mythical or of mythical proportions it is very great or amazing.
His skill with the baseball bat was mythical.
myth: A myth is a story about gods and great heroes. Usually these gods are seen as very human, but with great power. The word myth is usually used for stories from old religions that few people believe any more.
There are many myths about the Norse god Thor.
A myth is a story that is not true.
A myth is something many people believe but that is not true.
It is only a myth that people use only 10% of their brains.
mythology: Mythology is the study of stories about gods. Such stories are called myths.
A mythology is all the myths from a certain religion.
A mythology is all the background stories from a fictional world.
Tolkien invented an complex mythology for Middle Earth.
mysterious: If something is mysterious, it is something that cannot be explained or is puzzling.
mysteriously: If something is done mysteriously, it is done in an unexplainable or puzzling way.
myanmar: Myanmar is a country in Southeast Asia. It is officially known as the Union of Myanmar and it was previously called Burma.
mystique: A mystique is a mystery, a mysterious aura.
mymensingh: Mymensingh is a district in Bangladesh
myron: Myron is a male given name.
myometrium: The myometrium is the thick wall of the uterus made of smooth muscle.
The cells of the myometrium get larger during pregnancy.
mystical: If something is mystical, it inspires a sense of spiritual mystery, awe, and fascination.
myriagon: A polygon with ten thousand sides and ten thousand angles.
mystify: If you mystify a person, you confuse them thoroughly.
mystified: A mystified person is puzzled or confused.
myrrh: Myrrh is a type of resin that produces a sweet smell.
myrtle: Myrtle is an evergreen shrub or small tree of the genus Myrtus. It is native to southern Europe and north Africa.
Myrtle is a dark green shade that resembles the color of Myrtus leaves.
mythify: If you mythify something, you make it mythical.
mycology: Mycology is the study of fungi.
mycologist: A mycologist is a person who studies fungi.
myriad: A myriad of something is a very big quantity of something
A myriad something is very many of something
myxomatosis: Myxomatosis is a lethal illness of rabbits.
